title: Polka Dots
description: Fill the canvas with a grid of coral (0.95, 0.4, 0.35) dots on cream (0.96, 0.92, 0.82). The grid has 4 cells across the canvas, so each cell is 0.5 wide in the -1 to 1 space. A dot sits in the middle of each cell and has radius 0.3 of the cell's size. Dot edges are smooth.
hintText: Multiply uv by 4.0 to get four cells, then fract() gives each cell its own 0 to 1 coordinates. Subtract 0.5 to put the origin in the cell center, and draw a circle there.
